regime_context: The detector shows a broad (8 of 16 eligible), non-one-narrative regime with Oil & Gas Producers holding a wide leadership margin (score 2.24 vs 0.847 for Big Banks) but flagged crowded. The absolute-trend gate does help this market historically (gate_helps: true), the only validated edge is drawdown/shakeout control, and the track record of 117 calls shows hit rate ~60% but directional accuracy only 0.316 — so confidence in any directional lean should default to low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Oil & Gas's crowding (z 1.18) and mixed trend-health resolves into confirmed leadership handoff to Big Banks — the observable condition to retire this watch is a sustained crossover where ZEB.TO closes above XEG.TO on a 10-day lookback for 3 consecutive sessions.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks rank #2, are trend-eligible, have durability 0.71 (trend-tagged), and are NOT crowded (z 0.44), unlike the crowded leader Oil & Gas. This is the highest-scoring non-crowded trend-eligible theme, offering leadership exposure without the crowding caution attached to the #1 name. Supported by rank, trend-gate eligibility, durability, and crowding legs.
theses.dissent: Financials can mean-revert sharply on rate or credit shocks; the rank itself has no forward alpha (rank-IC ~0), and track record directional accuracy of 0.316 means prior directional calls have mostly missed.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms XEG.TO by 3% over any 10-day stretch before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas leads decisively (score 2.24, rank 1) with broad participation (breadth 0.929) and trend-gate eligibility. However it is crowded (z 1.18), which is a size-down caution only — not a fade. The trend gate is the only validated edge and it is on. Lean overweight but restrained by the crowding flag.
theses.dissent: Crowded leadership with mixed trend-health (hurst mixed, not trend) has historically marked attention tops rather than continuation; the leader is the documented failure mode for chasing.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO gives back its leadership margin to XIC (or the broad TSX) and falls below ZEB.TO on a 10-day lookback before the check-by date

theses.subject: Telecom
theses.thesis: Telecom ranks #13, is not trend-eligible (eligible: false), has durability 0.40, and weakest relative score among liquid proxies. In a regime where the only validated edge is staying power via the trend gate, being ineligible means the detector offers no support for holding it. Lean underweight as a trend-discipline expression.
evidence: durability_bar: 0.40, hurst_tag: trend but below gate
theses.dissent: Telecom is defensively owned for yield and can outperform in risk-off; the trend gate is a drawdown-avoidance tool, not a return forecaster, and being ineligible does not mean it will fall.

falsifier.text: XCD.TO outperforms XIC by 5% over any 20-day stretch before the check-by date
